question: Are Later/Previously and Tomorrow/Earlier implemented as two stable cue-conditioned response modes inside the same block9 H1/H4 and block11 H3 readers?

authority.ood_terminal: cue_specific: writer scalar transfers but Later/Previously response axes retain only 49% on Tomorrow/Earlier

novelty: No prior experiment fits response modes independently on both cue lexicons, cross-installs them, and tests their two-mode span and complement on heldout lexical groups and alternate frames.

frozen_design.split: within each corpus, alternating A1 lexical pairs form balanced 16-row fit and heldout sets; all 32 A2 rows transfer
frozen_design.reader_modes: one uncentered fit SVD axis per corpus at block9 H1/H4 and block11 H3
frozen_design.control: own-mode and joint-span installations on each corpus's 32 aligned P rows

predictions.pred_a_authority_and_closure: all capture/reconstruction identity checks pass and full response is donorward on every answer-changing row
predictions.pred_b_own_modes_stable: own-mode recovery is [0.70,1.20] of full response with donorward fraction >=0.90 on both heldout and A2 splits of both corpora
predictions.pred_c_cross_modes_distinct: cross-mode recovery is at least 0.20 below own-mode recovery in each corpus's A1 heldout split
predictions.pred_d_joint_span_sufficient: joint span recovery is [0.85,1.20] with donorward fraction >=0.90 and complement absolute fraction <=0.20 on all four answer-changing splits
predictions.pred_e_joint_span_selective: joint-span absolute normalized P effect <=0.20 in both corpora
predictions.pred_f_price_exact: 72 forwards, 1760 examples, 480 unique records, zero scalars/backwards/updates

terminal_rules.invalid: authority, balanced split, identity, closure, coverage, finiteness, or price fails
terminal_rules.shared_mode: own and joint modes work but cross-mode distinctness fails
terminal_rules.unrelated_circuits: own modes work but their joint span does not transfer or has material complement/collateral
terminal_rules.null: one or both own modes fail heldout causal stability

interpretation_limits: Two response modes are an operational causal quotient, not yet a symbolic explanation of why cue tokens select a mode.
This is circuit grouping/splitting: native reader components are fixed, while their within-reader response modes may split by cue family.
The response coefficients remain oracle projections in this factorial; coefficient compilation is evaluated separately.
